snippet.title: DK64 RECOMP RELEASE ANNOUNCEMENT
snippet.description:
https://dk64recomp.com/

Play DK64 like you've never experienced before with features such as high resolution and high frame rate. Playable on Windows, Mac OS and Linux!

This program contains no copyrighted assets. The user must provide their DK64 rom to play it.

No generative AI was used at any point in the process of making the DK64 Recompiled program.
